skills.name: Prompt Chaining
skills.when_to_use: Split a task into ordered stages and feed each stage's output into the next prompt.
skills.when_not_to_use: Skip it when subtasks are independent or a single prompt already answers reliably.
failure_modes: Error in an early stage propagates silently to the end
Unparsed free text between stages breaks the next prompt
Latency and cost grow linearly with chain length
Context lost because only the last output is forwarded

skills.name: Routing
skills.when_to_use: Classify the incoming request and dispatch it to one specialized handler, tool, or sub-agent.
skills.when_not_to_use: Skip it when there is exactly one valid handler or the path is fixed in advance.
failure_modes: Overlapping route descriptions make selection non-deterministic
No fallback route, so unmatched inputs dead-end
Router hallucinates a route id that does not exist
One misroute derails the whole downstream workflow

skills.name: Parallelization
skills.when_to_use: Run independent subtasks concurrently and join their results before the next step.
skills.when_not_to_use: Skip it when a subtask needs another's output or shared state is mutated.
failure_modes: Hidden dependency between branches yields inconsistent results
Rate limits or quota exhaustion from burst fan-out
One branch fails and the aggregator receives nothing
Interleaved logs make debugging and tracing hard

skills.name: Reflection
skills.when_to_use: Critique a draft against explicit criteria and regenerate it until the criteria are met.
skills.when_not_to_use: Skip it when latency or cost matters more than output quality.
failure_modes: Loop never converges without a hard iteration cap
Self-critique rubber-stamps its own errors; use a separate critic
Accumulated drafts overflow the context window
Cost and latency multiply by the number of iterations

skills.name: Tool Use
skills.when_to_use: Declare external functions and let the model emit a structured call when it needs real-world data or actions.
skills.when_not_to_use: Skip it when the answer is already in context or no side effect is required.
failure_modes: Vague tool descriptions cause wrong-tool selection
Hallucinated or malformed arguments fail schema validation
Unvalidated side effects fire without confirmation
Tool errors returned raw to the model trigger retry loops

skills.name: Planning
skills.when_to_use: Decompose a high-level goal into an ordered, dependency-aware list of executable steps before acting.
skills.when_not_to_use: Skip it when one tool call or a known fixed procedure completes the request.
failure_modes: Over-planning trivial tasks wastes tokens and time
Plan assumes tools or data that do not exist
No replanning hook, so the agent follows a stale plan
Steps too coarse for an executor to act on

skills.name: Multi-Agent Collaboration
skills.when_to_use: Split a multi-domain goal across specialized agents coordinated by handoff, hierarchy, or debate.
skills.when_not_to_use: Skip it when one agent with the right tools already solves the task.
failure_modes: Coordination overhead exceeds the benefit of specialization
Agents duplicate work or deadlock waiting on each other
Context is lost or distorted at each handoff
Errors compound across agents with no shared critic

skills.name: Memory Management
skills.when_to_use: Separate short-term session state from long-term persistent recall and write to each explicitly.
skills.when_not_to_use: Skip it for single-turn, stateless requests with no personalization.
failure_modes: Unbounded history growth overflows the context window
Mutating state in place instead of via a state delta loses events
Stale or contradictory long-term facts poison later turns
Sensitive data persisted without scoping or expiry

skills.name: Learning and Adaptation
skills.when_to_use: Update the agent's strategy, prompts, or code from measured outcomes of past runs.
skills.when_not_to_use: Skip it when the environment is static or changes cannot be evaluated objectively.
failure_modes: Optimizing a proxy metric that diverges from the real goal
Self-modification with no overseer or rollback path
Overfitting to a small benchmark set
Unbounded evolution loops burning budget

skills.name: Model Context Protocol
skills.when_to_use: Expose or consume tools, resources, and prompts over MCP so capabilities are discoverable at runtime.
skills.when_not_to_use: Skip it when a fixed, small set of local functions is enough; call them directly.
failure_modes: Server discovery returns tools the agent has no permission to call
Protocol or schema version drift between client and server
Filesystem or network scope wider than the task needs
Latency from chatty round trips per tool call

skills.name: Goal Setting and Monitoring
skills.when_to_use: State a measurable objective with success checks and re-evaluate progress after every step.
skills.when_not_to_use: Skip it when success is trivially observable in a single response.
failure_modes: Unmeasurable goals make the monitor unable to stop
Monitoring only at the end, so drift is caught too late
Agent declares success without verifying criteria
No iteration or time budget, so the loop runs forever

skills.name: Exception Handling and Recovery
skills.when_to_use: Detect tool and API failures, then retry, fall back, degrade, or escalate under an explicit policy.
skills.when_not_to_use: Skip it for pure in-context reasoning with no external calls or side effects.
failure_modes: Retrying non-transient errors such as invalid input or insufficient funds
Swallowing errors so failures look like successes
Retry storms without backoff or a cap
Fallback path is itself untested and also fails

skills.name: Human-in-the-Loop
skills.when_to_use: Pause for human approval before any irreversible, high-risk, or ambiguous action.
skills.when_not_to_use: Skip it for reversible low-stakes actions where approval latency dominates the work.
failure_modes: Escalating everything, which destroys throughput
Approval requests lacking the context to decide
Reviewer rubber-stamping under volume pressure
Sensitive data exposed to reviewers without redaction

skills.name: Knowledge Retrieval (RAG)
skills.when_to_use: Retrieve relevant external snippets and append them to the prompt so answers are grounded and citable.
skills.when_not_to_use: Skip it when the answer needs no external facts or the corpus is small enough to pass inline.
failure_modes: Retrieval misses the answer, so the model fills the gap by guessing
Chunks too small to carry context or too large to fit
Stale index served as current fact
Answer not attributable because sources are dropped

skills.name: Inter-Agent Communication (A2A)
skills.when_to_use: Delegate tasks across framework boundaries over A2A, discovering peers through their Agent Cards.
skills.when_not_to_use: Skip it when all agents live in one process; call them directly instead.
failure_modes: Agent Card overstates capabilities, so delegation fails late
Network partition leaves tasks orphaned in a pending state
Multi-turn context lost across the input-required boundary
No auth on endpoints, so any caller can drive the agent

skills.name: Resource-Aware Optimization
skills.when_to_use: Classify request complexity, then spend the cheapest model, tool, and context that meets the quality bar.
skills.when_not_to_use: Skip it when every request needs maximum quality or budget is not a constraint.
inputs: model and tool tiers with costs
failure_modes: Router misjudges complexity and downgrades a hard task
Router overhead costs more than it saves on cheap requests
Budget tracked per call but never in aggregate
Silent quality degradation with no signal to the caller

skills.name: Reasoning Techniques
skills.when_to_use: Make intermediate reasoning explicit with chain-of-thought, tree search, ReAct, or self-correction before answering.
skills.when_not_to_use: Skip it for lookups and formatting where one pass is already correct.
failure_modes: Fluent but wrong reasoning traces that read as justification
Tree search explodes combinatorially without pruning
ReAct loops repeat the same failed action
Traces leaked to users expose internal or sensitive detail

skills.name: Guardrails and Safety Patterns
skills.when_to_use: Layer input validation, output filtering, behavioral constraints, and tool restrictions around every agent call.
skills.when_not_to_use: Skip heavyweight moderation only in closed, offline runs with no user-facing output.
failure_modes: Single-layer defense bypassed by jailbreak or injection
Over-blocking legitimate requests and eroding usefulness
Guardrail latency and cost added to every call
Static rules that decay as attack patterns evolve

skills.name: Evaluation and Monitoring
skills.when_to_use: Score outputs and trajectories against defined metrics continuously, in development and in production.
skills.when_not_to_use: Skip formal evaluation for throwaway one-off runs nobody will depend on.
inputs: test cases or evalset with ground truth
outputs: trajectory diff against the ideal path
failure_modes: Only final answers scored, so bad trajectories pass
LLM-as-judge inherits the generator's bias
Metrics that no longer track user value
Drift undetected because no baseline was stored

skills.name: Prioritization
skills.when_to_use: Rank competing tasks by urgency, importance, dependencies, and cost, then act on the top item.
skills.when_not_to_use: Skip it when there is one task or a fixed queue order already applies.
failure_modes: Criteria weights unstated, so rankings are unreproducible
Re-ranking every tick causes thrash and starvation
Dependencies ignored, so blocked work is scheduled first
Low-priority items starve forever with no aging rule

skills.name: Exploration and Discovery
skills.when_to_use: Generate, critique, and evolve hypotheses to surface unknown unknowns in an open-ended problem space.
skills.when_not_to_use: Skip it when the solution space is known and the task is to optimize within it.
failure_modes: Unbounded search burns budget with no stopping rule
Plausible-sounding hypotheses never empirically tested
Generator and reviewer collapse onto the same bias
Exploration triggers irreversible actions on real systems
